nature_zh: 场地与运营主体对接就绪材料：一页式试点说明，处于「可发出」状态。本文件是材料本身，不是邀约记录——截至登记日，本方案团队未与任何场地方、运营主体或授权主体发生接触，不存在任何意向、约定或承诺；材料的发出与否、发往何处，由提交方在授权主体确认的框架下另行决定
nature_en: Site and operator outreach-readiness material: a one-page pilot brief in a ready-to-send state. This file is the material itself, not a record of outreach — as of the registration date the team has approached no site owner, operator or authorising body, and no intent, arrangement or commitment exists; whether and where to send it is a separate decision under the authorising body's framework
pilot_subject_zh: OP-04 连续通行断点 · ALT-A 横向接口升级段（大钟寺片区）——一次 L0→L1 的可逆原型试点：不动土建、构件可整体拆除、全程按 G0—G3 闸门推进
pilot_subject_en: OP-04 continuity break · ALT-A cross-link upgrade (Dazhongsi area) — a reversible L0→L1 prototype pilot: no groundworks, all components fully removable, run through gates G0—G3
what_we_bring_zh: 节点深化图版（1:500/1:200/1:50，八要素设计目标值，visual/op04-detail 双语）
九十天实施包（分期、概念级预算区间、采购与可逆性要求、RACI、班表与响应目标、投保建议、维护与退出成本，visual/assets/op04-implementation-pack.json）
服务等价基准 SEB v0.4.0（CC BY-SA 4.0 已授予、两例外部采用、双校验器可复演）作为验收判据
伦理与同意协议模板包（ethics-protocol.json）与失败样本公开登记纪律
全部过程数据按回执机制公开，可随时核查
what_we_bring_en: The node detailing plate (1:500/1:200/1:50, eight-element design targets, bilingual)

The ninety-day implementation pack (phasing, concept-level budget ranges, procurement and reversibility requirements, RACI, rosters and response targets, insurance suggestions, maintenance and exit costs)
The Service Equivalence Baseline SEB v0.4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0 granted, two external adoptions, two replayable checkers) as the acceptance criteria
The ethics and consent protocol template pack and the public failed-sample register discipline
Every process record published under the receipt mechanism, checkable at any time
what_we_need_zh: 场地使用授权（限定范围、限定时段、可撤回）
一次联合现场审计（无障碍专业人员与参与者代表共同复核断点，即节点既定 human_handoff 角色）
责任与保险安排的确认（按实施包建议共同商定）
一位可署名的场地或运营对接人（角色而非个人身份，进入 RACI）
what_we_need_en: Site-use permission (bounded scope, bounded hours, revocable)
One joint site audit (accessibility professionals and participant representatives reviewing the break together — the node's declared human_handoff role)
Confirmation of liability and insurance arrangements (settled together per the pack's suggestions)
One named site or operations contact (a role, not a personal identity, entering the RACI)
boundaries_zh: 全程可逆、可退出：任何一方可依既定停止条件叫停，停止即停止、不以限期整改替代；退出时恢复原状、数据按伦理协议处置；本材料不构成商业要约、合作声明或任何承诺；联系路径经本次征集的公开渠道进行
boundaries_en: Reversible and exitable throughout: any party may stop under the stated stop conditions — a stop is a stop, never replaced by a corrective deadline; on exit the site is restored and data handled per the ethics protocol; this material constitutes no commercial offer, partnership statement or commitment of any kind; contact runs through the open call's public channels
status_zh: 就绪待发；无既有接触、无既有意向（如实登记）
status_en: Ready to send; no prior contact and no existing intent (registered as fact)
